## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Starts forcing one or more players to be a specific hero and, if necessary, respawns them immediately in their current location. This will be the only hero available to the player or players until the [Stop Forcing Player To Be Hero](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/stop%2Bforcing%2Bplayer%2Bto%2Bbe%2Bhero) action is executed.

## Snippet

```
Start Forcing Player To Be Hero(Event Player, Hero(Tracer));
```

> The player or players who will be forced to be a specific hero.

> ==**Hero**==
````
